profile.subtitleJa: この書で「イスラエルの子ら」と呼ばれる集団。
profile.summaryJa: 列王記下2:12でエリシャは「イスラエルの戦車と騎兵」と叫びます。ここではイスラエルの民を指す集団名として扱います。
profile.identityNoteJa: 「イスラエルの子ら」は、人々の集団を指す用例です。

facts.textJa: 主はイスラエルをアラムの支配から救い出し、民が以前のように天幕で暮らすようにしたと記されます。
イスラエルの子らは主の戒めに背き、他の民の慣習に従ったと総括されます。
イスラエルの子らが罪を重ね、主の前から退けられた経緯が列挙されます。
ヒゼキヤは、イスラエルの子らが礼拝した青銅の蛇を砕き、「ネフシュタン」と呼びました。
マナセの行いは、主がイスラエルの子らの前から退けた諸国の忌むべき行いと比較されます。
列王記下3:3は、ヤロブアムがイスラエルに罪を犯させたと記します。
列王記下3:6でヨラムはイスラエル全体を召集します。
列王記下3:24は、イスラエル人がモアブ人を打ったと記します。
列王記下3:27は、イスラエルに大きな怒りが及んだと記します。
列王記下7:13では、イスラエルの残った人々と滅びた人々が比べられます。

wikipedia.title: Israelites
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事は、Israelitesが“Children of Israel”とも呼ばれる古代の人々であると説明しています。これは本文の集団名に関する関連資料です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their little ones in pieces, and rip up their pregnant women.”
(The LORD gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before.

But the LORD was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.

But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.
It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
and walked in the statutes of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they made.

The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against the LORD their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;
The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn’t depart from them

The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they possessed Samaria and lived in its cities.

To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear the LORD, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.
He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
But they didn’t listen, and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.
Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.
Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.
King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.
When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”
WEBは、主がイスラエルを御前から退けたと記す。

review.identityCheckJa: 「イスラエルの子ら」という人々の集団を指す用例を採る。2KI17:34の「イスラエル」はヤコブ個人の改名に関する文脈であり、この集団プロフィールには含めない。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 常時表示は初出節で明らかな情報に限定し、後の出来事は根拠節でゲートした。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: L191 explicitly says Israelites are also known as Children of Israel and describes them as a people; it supports a collective reading without deciding every occurrence in Kings.
